description:
Quarterly UK auction statistics by postcode district: lots offered, lots
    sold, the sale rate, and average guide, achieved and net yield.

    Use this for the shape of a local auction market over time — is it clearing,
    are yields moving, is stock rising. For individual comparables use
    auction_lots.

    READ `n_guide` AND `n_achieved` BEFORE COMPARING THE AVERAGES. They are
    computed over DIFFERENT POPULATIONS: a guide price is published for most
    lots, a hammer price by a minority of auctioneers. Subtracting one average
    from the other does not give an uplift, a discount, or any meaningful
    number — the two sets are not the same lots.

    Each row carries a `comparable` flag that is false when the two populations
    are too unbalanced for the difference to mean anything. When it is false,
    report the two figures separately with their counts, and say why.

    `quarter_from`/`quarter_to` are the first day of a quarter (2024-01-01,
    2024-04-01, ...). UK only. Free.
name: auction_stats
title: Auction statistics by district
